what: Hovering a ‹Next section› big band link makes the lit photo rise diagonally from below over the dimmed (dark) photo — a trapezoid whose right end rises to halfway first, .45s Power3.in, then flattening into a rectangle in .45s Power3.out. On leaving, it peels away upward diagonally at the same tempo and disappears (the right side comes down to halfway first, then closes at the top edge)

options.[data-fx-part=on]: Lit panel (inside the element, required) — bright photo·color panel
options.dur: Half-beat length in seconds, default .45 — twice that for each enter and exit
options.slant: Right-end height (%) at the first diagonal rising step, default 50
options.ease-in · ease-out: First-half and second-half curves, default power3.in · power3.out

use: stay
note: On touch devices (no hover) the panel is hidden and nothing is attached — the original also hides the opened panel on phones

from.where: about.html·bar.html .bh-navarea__block (original cp-nav-area .js-efct-btn — with TimelineMax the clip-path of .on goes polygon(0 0,100 50,100 100,0 100) .45 Power3.easeIn → (0 0,100 0,100 100,0 100) .45 Power3.easeOut, and on leaving (0 0,100 0,100 50,0 0) → (0 0,100 0,100 0,0 0))
